problem.question: Marianne was 20 years old when Bella was 8 years old. How old will Marianne be when Bella turns 18?
problem.answer:
Marianne is 20 - 8 = <<20-8=12>>12 years older than Bella.
Bella will turn 18 in 18 - 8 = <<18-8=10>>10 years.
So, Marianne will be 20 + 10 = <<20+10=30>>30 years old then.
#### 30

generation.text:
When Bella turns 18, Marianne will be 20 + 18 = 38 years old.
The final answer is \boxed{38}.
